progress_summary: The v1.9 candidate satisfies the repository QA strategy in .opchain/qa.yaml. The clean pre-merge ledger passed all 11 mapped workflow gates with no warning or skip: 43 Vitest files and 579 tests, Worker build, Astro check/build, Playwright e2e, and Lighthouse budgets. Focused security regressions passed 113 tests before the full run. One earlier Astro asset-move failure was isolated as transient; an immediate standalone build and the clean full ledger rerun both passed.

progress_table.label: MCP, retention, release, and hardening contracts

key_decisions: Coverage enforcement remains governed by .opchain/qa.yaml; this release does not silently strengthen optional budgets.
A transient build failure does not become a pass by dismissal: isolated and complete clean reruns were both required and passed.
Live HTTP controls remain post-deploy acceptance checks and are not misrepresented as pre-deploy proof.
